errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с приходи в милиарди долари.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis itself is not labeled. The unit 'милиарди долари' (billions of dollars) applies to the blue area data series as indicated by the legend, but the orange data points are in percentages. Ascribing this label to the entire axis is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: Площта започва от стойност 2.2 милиарда долара през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The starting value for the blue area in 2017 is 102,2, not 2.2.

errors.text_span: Представена е и оранжева площ, представляваща растежа.
errors.evidence: The orange data series, 'Ръст' (Growth), is represented by percentage values placed as text labels above the blue area for each year, not as an 'оранжева площ' (orange area).

errors.text_span: и постепенно се увеличава, достигайки 16% през 2022 и 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the orange data series as 'постепенно се увеличава' (gradually increases) is an over-generalization. The values fluctuate significantly: 0%, 31%, 16%, 22%, 10%, 16%, 16%.

errors.text_span: Върху площта са нанесени стойностите 31% за 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The value of 31% corresponds to the year 2018, not 2019. The value for 2019 is 16%.
The description of the orange data points is incomplete. It omits the values for 2018 (31%), 2019 (16%), and 2020 (22%).
